summary: Invalidate owner arrangement inventories when changes fall outside bounded stream windows

replay.detail: Uses existing admission-time arrangement heads and changed_index values. No replay, backfill or recovery is required.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema version change. Owner revisions use the existing arrangements_owner_changed_index.

rules.detail: No retention, checkpoint rule, projection digest or sealing transition changes. The existing local changed_index frontier remains excluded from shared projection digests.

compatibility.detail: Owner-wide arrangements subscriptions can now receive existing changes frames with empty upserts and removes, unchanged order and has_more, and a new snapshot fence when that owner's inventory revision changes. Clients needing complete inventories must paginate after every owner-wide changes frame, including empty ones. Selected-subject subscriptions remain resource-only. No new frame kind, field, wire schema, generated client API or capability version is introduced. Older servers can still miss outside-window changes; upgrade serving daemons for the stronger invalidation guarantee.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond an ordinary daemon restart. Reconnected subscriptions receive authoritative initial snapshots. Restart timing was not measured.

manual.detail: Upgrade serving daemons normally; no migration or inventory repair is required. Inventory consumers should keep one owner-wide subscription open and coalesce complete paginated rereads on snapshot and changes frames.

recovery.detail: No additional database recovery or rollback procedure is required. Rolling back restores the previous bounded-prefix-only notification behavior without modifying stored arrangements.
